headline: Gringo’s Goblins: Preseason Front Office Brief
executive_summary: Gringo’s Goblins is projected #11 of 16 with a 558.30 projected-starting-lineup C-AVI total, led by Emeka Egbuka, Kyren Williams, and Davante Adams. The immediate priority is improving the FLEX slot without weakening that core.
